result.reason: The redline is narrowly targeted and preserves the surrounding payment terms, but it does not clearly implement the fallback. “Then-current twelve (12) month term” could apply to each renewal term rather than only the current term, and “shall be trued up rather than applied as a penalty” provides no workable true-up calculation or mechanics. The operative language should expressly limit the commitment to the existing 12-month term and specify how reduced minimums and any final reconciliation are calculated.
